QUOTE: The library itself creates no threads. Concurrency comes only from the caller... Every mutex call site in the library sits behind `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`... `library/threading.c`... the function-pointer table (`mbedtls_mutex_lock` and friends, line 103)

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library/ creates no threads and that library/threading.c with the mutex wrappers and call sites exists for threaded callers when enabled. That covers both halves of the contrast.
